doc_friction.issue: 'Wheel speed loop' says the 3% gate holds true error to 2.8%; tests/wheel_loop_sweep.py on main gives 4.1% (the spin-up ramp landed after that note). Recorded in firmware/esp32/README.md, not rewritten.
Bare python3 lacks pytest; pyenv.py found /usr/bin/python3.13 quickly, as the note says. No friction beyond that.

deviations.why: The plain route drew the research track; the scheduled brief is the ventures brief, so routed with --task as prompt.md says.

notes: Cause: PeriodTach's 4-revolution mean trails the wheel ~2.5 revs (0.29 s at 510 rpm); fixed gains -> phase margin -48 deg (30 ms ESC, 0.2 s wheel). Fix: WheelLoop gains scale under LOOP_LOW_RPM=1500; SteadyGate holds >= GATE_HOLD_REVS=6 revolutions of the slowest wheel. tests/low_speed_loop_sweep.py (336 sim cases): never steady 20->0, fed >3% off 165->14, median steady 3.59->3.76 s. min_fit_rpm_sweep ESC 30 ms: 9/9 builds finish (3 aborted before); one 1,107 rpm wheel reads 1.48x its drop (spin worst 2.15->6.65% on the old six builds), left as the next item. Verification: run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots ok (340 tests, 184 s); test_host.py 97 passed; validate.py ok; post front matter/links/similarity ok. Simulation only.
